description: Type the 400 PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/postgres/{postgresId} answers when a request turns deletion protection on for an organization that does not have it: {"status": 400, "error": "BAD_REQUEST: Deletion protection is not enabled for this organization."}. The spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic BadRequest, which every invalid request body also answers. Observed live 2026-11-12 sending deletionProtection: true to a just-created Postgres service (request id 70b22266-6d60-4e37-b5a4-6cbf9af44402), which is why no Postgres service on this organization can have deletion protection, and why deletePostgresService never answers the 409 deleteService does: it deleted the unprotected service with 200.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The organization does not have the deletion protection feature, so a service cannot turn it on. Ask ClickHouse to enable it for the organization.

message.includes: Deletion protection is not enabled for this organization
